title: European occupation of South Africa
description: Trading companies from Europe occupied South Africa with arms and force; unlike India, a large number of Whites settled there and became local rulers.

title: Draft constitution by Motilal Nehru
description: Motilal Nehru and eight other Congress leaders drafted a constitution for India.

title: Karachi Session of INC
description: The Karachi session of the Indian National Congress discussed the shape of independent India’s constitution, emphasizing universal adult franchise and protection of minority rights.

title: Gandhi’s constitutional vision
description: Mahatma Gandhi wrote in his magazine Young India, expressing his vision of a constitution that would release India from "thralldom and patronage".

title: Provincial elections in British India
description: Elections were held to Provincial Legislatures and Ministries across British India; though not fully democratic, they helped Indians gain experience in governance.

title: Constituent Assembly elections
description: Elections to the Constituent Assembly were held.

title: First meeting of Constituent Assembly
description: The Constituent Assembly held its first meeting.

title: Independence and Partition of India
description: India attained independence and was partitioned into India and Pakistan; at least ten lakh people were killed in partition-related violence.

title: Apartheid policy in South Africa
description: The government of South Africa followed the official policy of apartheid, involving racial separation and ill-treatment of Blacks.

title: Adoption of the Indian Constitution
description: The Constituent Assembly adopted the Indian Constitution.

title: Indian Constitution comes into effect
description: The Indian Constitution came into effect, a day celebrated annually as Republic Day.

title: Resistance to apartheid intensifies
description: Blacks, coloureds, and Indians in South Africa began fighting apartheid through protest marches and strikes led by the African National Congress (ANC).

title: Life imprisonment of Mandela
description: Nelson Mandela and seven other leaders were sentenced to life imprisonment for opposing the apartheid regime.

title: 42nd Amendment to Indian Constitution
description: The words ‘Socialist’ and ‘Secular’ were added to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution, during the period of the Emergency, imposed by Prime Minister Indira Gandhi, by 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act.

title: End of apartheid
description: At midnight, the apartheid government ended and the new national flag of the Republic of South Africa was unfurled, marking the birth of a multi-racial democracy.
